blockers.statement: CP27 accepts one exact vecadd image and one submit per context/session. Reusable multi-dispatch, events/asynchrony, arbitrary OpenCL images and shapes, and model operators remain unproven.
The pinned normal Triton Python backend/driver/runtime, preload-aware launch, reusable sessions, model execution, stable multi-token inference, TP, and CCL remain unproven.

changes: Added a repository-local OpenCL 1.2 subset and normal host executable that compile vecadd.cl with the pinned local compiler/device libraries, supervise gem5 implicitly, submit through the self runtime, read C back, and validate the application-visible oracle.

Added a second exact gem5 execution variant for the 5160-byte gfx950 OpenCL vecadd image, with hash/ELF/metadata/ISA admission, dynamic workgroup observation for the accepted launch, C=A+B validation, C-only D2H correlation, cleanup, and zero fallback.

Installed the compiler, device libraries, runtime, libOpenCL, kernel sources, and executable into a versioned repository-local ROCm prefix under an environment-scrubbed build; no system ROCm/HIP/OpenCL provider or host GPU device is used.
Recorded normal OpenCL direct execution as the product gate and deferred profiling until a retained operator, layer, or model bottleneck materially blocks correctness coverage.
limitations: The accepted product path is restricted to the exact 5160-byte gfx950 vecadd HSACO with SHA-256 314ede16940432996c9fe190115408bf42744a8ab7d0036bf07b931e39c4cb19, zero descriptor preload, one 88-byte kernarg, and global/local sizes 1024/256.

The OpenCL subset is synchronous, one-dimensional, one-device, one-queue, and one-submit-per-context/session. Events, asynchronous queues, arbitrary source images, repeated dispatch, and general OpenCL conformance are not claimed.

The fsynced daemon trace is authoritative for GPUDispatcher/ComputeUnit execution; the normal application readback and CPU oracle are authoritative for bytes delivered to the user. Neither side alone proves the full product result.

The isolated v5 prefix contains the pinned compiler/device libraries and self-authored runtime/OpenCL stack. The freshly compiled gpuReadWrite provenance artifact is not substituted for the separately locked CP26 image.

Normal Triton Python, its 12-DWORD preload-aware launcher path, reusable device allocations/sessions, broader model operators, full-model execution, stable multi-token inference, TP, CCL, and all CPU/NVIDIA fallback remain false.
The retained sub-second wall observations and gem5 host-time value are diagnostic only, not performance or timing-model claims; profiling is conditional on a demonstrated workload bottleneck.
